question: What share of Vietnamese adults keep chay days, and how many days a month (0, 2, 4, 8 to 10, whole months)?
why_it_matters: It sets the size of the chay channel and the displacement arithmetic; no probability survey exists
cheapest_way_to_close: Add three questions to an existing nationally representative omnibus or the next VHLSS round; or buy a question on a face-to-face omnibus
owner_org_to_ask: General Statistics Office (NSO); Institute for Religious Studies (VASS); Pew Research Center; Kantar Worldpanel Vietnam

question: How much do household purchases of tofu, mushrooms and đồ chay rise on lunar 1st and 15th and in lunar months 1 and 7?
why_it_matters: Revealed demand by calendar day would replace press quotes with measured uplift
cheapest_way_to_close: Request a lunar-calendar cut of existing household panel or retailer scan data
owner_org_to_ask: Kantar Worldpanel Vietnam; NielsenIQ Vietnam; Saigon Co.op; Bach Hoa Xanh (Mobile World); WinCommerce

question: What are annual sales (tonnes and VND) of industrial đồ chay, by maker?
why_it_matters: No audited figure exists; needed to size the B2B ingredient opportunity
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the five largest makers for chay line volumes under NDA; check annual reports and AGM documents
owner_org_to_ask: Vissan; CJ Cau Tre; SG Food; Au Lac; An Nhien; Thoai An

question: How much protein do street, market and supermarket chay foods actually contain?
why_it_matters: The protein gap is the product opening; labels are sparse and unverified
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy 50 to 100 samples across three cities and run Kjeldahl protein tests
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute for Food Control (NIFC); university food labs; AltProtein Vietnam

question: How common is meat DNA or unsafe additives in chay products?
why_it_matters: Trust is the category's weak point; a prevalence figure would size the value of verified supply
cheapest_way_to_close: Apply the Can Tho University PCR kit to a stratified sample before Vu Lan
owner_org_to_ask: Can Tho University Biotechnology Institute; NIFC; provincial market surveillance

question: Would periodic chay eaters and strict vegetarians accept a higher-protein fungal or textured ingredient inside familiar chay formats at the same price?
why_it_matters: Stated interest is high but untested; this decides the ingredient strategy
cheapest_way_to_close: Blind sensory and choice test of reformulated chả, giò and há cảo chay at pagodas and chay shops
owner_org_to_ask: University food science departments; a chay manufacturer partner

question: What share of chay buyers require allium-free or egg-free products?
why_it_matters: Decides whether allium-free variants are a niche SKU or a requirement
cheapest_way_to_close: Short intercept survey at pagodas, chay shops and supermarket chay aisles in three regions
owner_org_to_ask: AltProtein Vietnam; Vietnam Buddhist Sangha contacts

question: How many chay restaurants are active on ShopeeFood, GrabFood and Google Maps by city, including Hue?
why_it_matters: Foody counts are cumulative and thin outside big cities
cheapest_way_to_close: Scripted count of platform listings with an 'chay' category or keyword, with a manual check of a sample
owner_org_to_ask: Platform data teams; any analyst with browser access

question: How many meals do pagoda kitchens serve and who supplies them?
why_it_matters: 18,544 Buddhist sites are a possible institutional buyer that nobody has sized
cheapest_way_to_close: Interview a sample of pagoda kitchens in Ho Chi Minh City, Hue and Hanoi
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam Buddhist Sangha; provincial Sangha committees

question: Is chay observance rising among young urban people, or only chay dining supply?
why_it_matters: Rising observance would make chay a displacement route, not just a channel
cheapest_way_to_close: Repeat-panel questions in an existing youth or consumer tracker
owner_org_to_ask: Decision Lab; Q&Me; Cimigo; university survey units

question: Do people who eat chay on set days eat more meat on other days?
why_it_matters: Compensation would reduce the impact value of adding chay days
cheapest_way_to_close: Food diary study across a lunar month in 200 households
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute of Nutrition; university nutrition departments

question: What is the true national tofu output, including craft villages?
why_it_matters: USSEC implies about 31,500 t, which looks far too low against craft village volumes
cheapest_way_to_close: Count craft village output from provincial industry and trade departments; buy the USSEC report
owner_org_to_ask: Hanoi Department of Industry and Trade; USSEC; soybean importers

question: How much mushroom is consumed domestically, and what share is eaten on chay days?
why_it_matters: Mushrooms are the chay protein that spikes in price; they compete with any fungal product
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the mushroom association and wholesale markets for volumes by month
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam mushroom producers; Binh Dien and Long Bien wholesale markets

question: Did Vissan set any chay-specific target for 2026?
why_it_matters: The brief refers to Vissan 2026 chay targets; we found none in AGM coverage
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the 2026 AGM documents directly or ask Vissan investor relations

question: How large are Vietnamese vegan online communities and festivals, verified?
cheapest_way_to_close: Read public follower counts on platforms; ask organisers for attendance records
